title: Forge — Cost
_comment: Cost: spend per team/repo/model, budget-burn rate, anomaly alerts (docs/14 §6, docs/08 §17).

list.name: repo
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT repo_id FROM forge.session_event ORDER BY 1

targets.query: SELECT repo_id, sum(cost_usd) AS spend FROM forge.session_event WHERE event_type = 'cost_event' AND ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY repo_id ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT model, sum(cost_usd) AS spend FROM forge.session_event WHERE event_type = 'cost_event' AND ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY model ORDER BY spend DESC

panels.title: Budget-burn rate (cumulative spend/day)
panels._comment: Daily cumulative spend — the budget-burn slope. Anomaly alert fires on sudden spike (docs/08 §17).

targets.query: SELECT toDate(ts) AS d, sum(cost_usd) AS daily_spend FROM forge.session_event WHERE event_type = 'cost_event' AND ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

alert.name: Cost anomaly — daily spend spike
alert.message: Daily spend exceeded the 7-day moving average by >50%.

panels.title: Cost per successful merged PR (the key efficiency metric)
panels._comment: The PRD's leading indicator (docs/01 §3): LLM spend per successful merged PR. From the session_outcome_daily MV (docs/12 §5).

targets.query: SELECT avg(total_cost) FROM forge.session_outcome_daily_table WHERE outcome = 'merged' AND toDate(ended_at) > $__timeFrom
